title: Mixed-Methods Research — Numbers and Stories Together

hook.en: A trial says the programme worked a little. Interviews say patients hated the trips to clinic. Which is true? Both. Mixed-methods research puts numbers and stories in the same study so that each can explain the other.
hook.ur: Trial kehta hai programme ne thora kaam kiya. Interviews kehte hain mareez clinic ke chakkar se nafrat karte thay. Kaun sa sach hai? Dono. Mixed-methods research numbers aur kahaniyan ek hi study mein rakhti hai taake har ek doosre ki wazahat kare.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain why and when to mix methods, name the three core designs (convergent, explanatory sequential, exploratory sequential), and plan simple integration of the two kinds of data.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke tareeqe kyun aur kab milayein, teen bunyadi designs (convergent, explanatory sequential, exploratory sequential) ke naam batayenge, aur dono qism ke data ke saade integration ka plan banayenge.

text.en: **Mixed-methods research** collects and analyses both quantitative and qualitative data in one study and brings them together to answer a question that neither could answer alone. The key word is **integration**: the two strands must talk to each other, not just sit side by side. Common reasons: to explain surprising numbers, to design a better measure, to understand why a trial worked or did not, and to check whether two sources agree.
text.ur: **Mixed-methods research** ek hi study mein quantitative aur qualitative dono qism ka data jama aur tajziya karti hai aur unhein mila kar aisa sawal hal karti hai jo koi akeli na kar sakti. Aham lafz **integration** hai: dono hisson ko ek doosre se baat karni chahiye, sirf saath saath nahi baithna. Aam wajuhaat: hairat angez numbers ki wazahat, behtar naap banana, samajhna ke trial kyun kaam kiya ya nahi, aur jaanchna ke do zarai mutafiq hain ya nahi.

text.en: Think of **a doctor's blood test and the patient's story**. The test shows the sugar is high. The story reveals the patient eats late at night after long shifts. One without the other gives half a picture. Together they point to a plan that fits.
text.ur: **Doctor ka blood test aur mareez ki kahani** sochein. Test dikhata hai sugar zyada hai. Kahani batati hai mareez lambi shiftoon ke baad raat ko der se khata hai. Ek doosre ke baghair aadhi tasveer. Milkar woh aise plan ki taraf ishara karte hain jo fit ho.

rows.en: Collect both kinds of data at the same time, analyse separately, then compare
rows.ur: Dono qism ka data ek saath jama karein, alag tajziya karein, phir muqabla

rows.en: Pain scores and interviews at the same visit show whether they tell the same story
rows.ur: Ek hi visit par dard ke scores aur interviews dikhate hain ke kahani ek hai ya nahi

rows.en: Numbers first, then interviews to explain the numbers
rows.ur: Pehle numbers, phir numbers ki wazahat ke liye interviews

rows.en: A trial finds little change; interviews with those who did not improve explain why
rows.ur: Trial mein kam tabdeeli; na behtar hone walon se interviews wajah batate hain

rows.en: Interviews first to learn what matters, then numbers to measure or test it
rows.ur: Pehle interviews ye jaanne ke liye ke kya ahem hai, phir numbers naapne ya aazmane ke liye

rows.en: Interviews reveal key barriers, then a questionnaire measures how common they are
rows.ur: Interviews ahem rukawatein batate hain, phir questionnaire naapta hai woh kitni aam hain

question.en: A trial of a falls programme finds no overall benefit. The team then interviews participants to learn why many stopped attending. What design is this?
question.ur: Girne se bachao programme ke trial mein koi kul faida nahi milta. Phir team shirkat karne walon se interview karti hai ke bohat se kyun aana chhor gaye. Yeh kaun sa design hai?

text.en: Convergent, because both used the same participants
text.ur: Convergent, kyunke dono mein wohi shirkat karne wale thay

feedback.en: Convergent collects both at the same time.
feedback.ur: Convergent dono ek saath jama karta hai.

text.en: Explanatory sequential: numbers first, then interviews to explain them
text.ur: Explanatory sequential: pehle numbers, phir unki wazahat ke liye interviews

feedback.en: Yes — the qualitative strand explains the quantitative result.
feedback.ur: Haan — qualitative hissa quantitative nateeje ki wazahat karta hai.

text.en: Exploratory sequential, because interviews came second
text.ur: Exploratory sequential, kyunke interviews baad mein aaye

feedback.en: Exploratory starts with the qualitative strand.
feedback.ur: Exploratory qualitative hisse se shuru hota hai.

text.en: Converting all interviews to a single number
text.ur: Saare interviews ko ek number mein badalna

feedback.en: That removes the depth that qualitative data give.
feedback.ur: Yeh us gehraai ko khatam karta hai jo qualitative data deta hai.

text.en: Bringing the two kinds of data together so that they inform or explain each other
text.ur: Dono qism ke data ko ek saath laana taake woh ek doosre ko batayein ya samjhayein

feedback.en: Yes — side-by-side reporting alone is not enough.
feedback.ur: Haan — sirf saath saath report kaafi nahi.

text.en: Printing both results in the same paper
text.ur: Dono nateeje ek hi paper mein chhapna

question.en: When would you choose an exploratory sequential design?
question.ur: Aap exploratory sequential design kab chunenge?

text.en: When you already have a validated questionnaire and just want to repeat it
text.ur: Jab aap ke paas validated questionnaire ho aur sirf dohrana ho

feedback.en: Then a simple quantitative study is enough.
feedback.ur: Tab saada quantitative study kaafi hai.

text.en: When you do not yet know what matters and need interviews first to build a good questionnaire or intervention
text.ur: Jab aap ko abhi nahi pata kya ahem hai aur achha questionnaire ya intervention banane ke liye pehle interviews chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — qualitative first helps design the measure.
feedback.ur: Haan — pehle qualitative naap banane mein madad karta hai.

text.en: When you have no time for interviews
text.ur: Jab interviews ke liye waqt na ho

feedback.en: That is a reason to avoid it.

text.en: **Mixing for the sake of mixing.** Adding a few interviews to a survey without a clear purpose is not mixed-methods research. Say why you need both, which comes first and how they will be combined. Another trap is the "orphan strand": a qualitative part that is never used in the final conclusions. Use joint displays, tables that put the numbers and quotes side by side for each theme.
text.ur: **Sirf milane ke liye milana.** Survey mein bina saaf maqsad ke chand interviews jodna mixed-methods research nahi. Batayein ke dono kyun chahiye, pehle kaun sa aur kaise milenge. Ek aur jaal "yateem hissa" hai: qualitative hissa jo aakhri nateejon mein istemal na ho. Joint displays istemal karein, tables jo har theme ke liye numbers aur iqtebasat saath rakhein.

text.en: **Use mixed methods in service evaluation.** If you audit attendance numbers, add three short phone calls with people who stopped coming. The numbers tell you how big the problem is; the calls tell you what to change. This simple mix often leads to bigger improvements than either part alone.
text.ur: **Service evaluation mein mixed methods istemal karein.** Agar aap hazri ke numbers ka audit karte hain to un logon se teen chhoti phone calls jorein jo aana chhor gaye. Numbers batate hain masla kitna bara hai; calls batati hain kya badalna hai. Yeh saada mel aksar kisi ek hissay se zyada behtari laata hai.

question.en: Is mixed-methods research just "a trial plus some interviews"?
question.ur: Kya mixed-methods research sirf "trial aur kuch interviews" hai?

answer.en: Not necessarily. A true mixed-methods design plans both strands in advance, with an explicit link between them, and a "process evaluation" alongside a trial is a good example: the trial measures outcomes, while interviews and records explain how the intervention was delivered and received. The aim is a fuller answer than either part could give.
answer.ur: Zaroori nahi. Asal mixed-methods design dono hisson ko pehle se plan karta hai, un ke beech saaf rishte ke saath, aur trial ke saath "process evaluation" achhi misal hai: trial nateeje naapta hai, jabke interviews aur records batate hain ke intervention kaise di gayi aur kaise mili. Maqsad aisa mukammal jawab hai jo koi ek hissa nahi de sakta.

beats.patient: A clinic launches a text-message reminder for exercises. After three months, completion rose from 40 to 48 percent, a small gain. They interview 10 patients.
beats.assessment: Many say the messages came at the wrong time, were too general or arrived when they were working.
beats.treatment: They change the timing to patients' own chosen times and add a personal line from their therapist.
beats.reassess: Three months later, completion rose to 62 percent, and the team can explain why.

text.en: **Combine ethics, too.** Mixed studies often collect personal stories plus health data, so secure storage, consent for both parts and care in reporting small groups are essential. If interviews reveal safety concerns, such as unreported falls or harm, have a plan to act on them.
text.ur: **Akhlaqiyat bhi milayein.** Mixed studies aksar zaati kahaniyan aur sehat ka data jama karti hain, isliye mehfooz zakhira, dono hisson ke liye razamandi aur chhote groups ki report mein ehtiyat zaroori hain. Agar interviews mein safety ke khadshay saamne aayen, jaise ghair-report shuda girna ya nuqsan, to unpar amal karne ka plan rakhein.

text.en: Creswell and Plano Clark describe the three core designs and the central idea of integration at the design, methods and interpretation levels. A review of mixed-methods studies in health services research found that the quality of reporting was often weak, with many studies not clearly justifying the use of mixed methods or integrating the findings, which shows why a clear rationale and a joint display matter.
text.ur: Creswell aur Plano Clark teen bunyadi designs aur design, methods aur tabsira ki satah par integration ka markazi khayal bayan karte hain. Health services research mein mixed-methods studies ke ek review ne paya ke report ki quality aksar kamzor thi, bohat si studies mixed methods ke istemal ki saaf wajah nahi deti thin ya nateejon ko integrate nahi karti thin, jo dikhata hai ke saaf wajah aur joint display kyun ahem hain.

text.en: **Why, Order, Integrate.** Say why you mix, decide the order, and plan how the two strands will be integrated.
text.ur: **Kyun, Tarteeb, Integrate.** Batayein kyun milate hain, tarteeb tay karein, aur plan karein ke dono hisson ko kaise integrate karenge.

summary.en: Mixed-methods research combines numbers and stories to answer questions neither can answer alone.
summary.ur: Mixed-methods research numbers aur kahaniyon ko mila kar aise sawal hal karti hai jo koi akeli nahi kar sakti.

summary.en: Three core designs: convergent, explanatory sequential and exploratory sequential.
summary.ur: Teen bunyadi designs: convergent, explanatory sequential aur exploratory sequential.

summary.en: The key is integration, shown through a clear reason and a joint display.
summary.ur: Aham cheez integration hai, jo saaf wajah aur joint display se dikhti hai.

front.en: What is the key idea in mixed-methods research?
front.ur: Mixed-methods research ka aham khayal kya hai?

back.en: Integration of quantitative and qualitative data.
back.ur: Quantitative aur qualitative data ka integration.

front.en: Which design explains a number with interviews?
front.ur: Kaun sa design numbers ki wazahat interviews se karta hai?

front.en: Which design starts with interviews to build a measure?
front.ur: Kaun sa design naap banane ke liye interviews se shuru hota hai?

back.en: A table that places numbers and quotes side by side.
back.ur: Aisi table jo numbers aur iqtebasat saath saath rakhe.

note.en: The qualitative strand in more depth.
